native.cause: The new harness counted each one-step call as a complete controller unit and exceeded 640 instead of packing measured owner work within the declared 32768-step ceiling.
native.correction: Pack measured work at an 8192-step target within the unchanged 32768 ceiling, with one uninterrupted 90s/640-unit/5s-unit ledger and separate control charges.

native.cause: The test assumed WORKING after one operation; this fixture finishes its last net and correctly returns ROUTE_READY in that operation.
native.correction: Assert the exact ready transition and add a separate genuine active-state cancellation before advance; retain ownership, work and source-preservation checks.

native.cause: The test expected the earlier call's work count after a new rejected advance had correctly reported zero new work. Active and ready cleanup already matched their expected states.
native.correction: Check retained work before retry, zero new work after rejection, unchanged owner work/expansions and retired references.
